'''NX-88''' was a [[droid]] member of the [[Ganguls]] [[pirate]] gang during the [[High Republic Era]]. NX acted as the [[pilot]] for the Ganguls' flagship, the ''[[Rathtar's Revenge]]'', during the gang's raid on [[Deppani]] for [[starship]]s following a storm.<ref name="Heroes and Hotshots" /> NX-88 was later present with the Ganguls during their takeover of [[Yarrum Tower]].<ref name="Tower Run">{{YJA|Tower Run}}</ref> 

NX-88 had a [[Color|blue]] visor with brown plating and communicated in deep-toned [[Binary|droidspeak]]. NX exhibited impatience during the Ganguls' earlier raids, but willingly followed orders from the group's leader [[Sellaccc Orryak]].<ref name="Heroes and Hotshots" /> Despite remaining on board the ''Rathtar's Revenge'', NX still displayed enthusiasm for the gang's pursuits, such as during the prelude to the takeover of Yarrum Tower.<ref name="Tower Run" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
NX-88 first appeared in the episode "[[Heroes and Hotshots]]" from the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]] of the animated series [[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]. The character was designed by [[Chris Blackstock]].<ref name="Blackstock">{{WebCite|url=https://blackstockart.com/young-jedi-adventures|text=Young Jedi Adventures|work=[[Chris Blackstock]]'s [https://blackstockart.com official website]|archivedate=20250306020751}}</ref>
